n, m, md = map(int, input().split())

N = 500
ch = [[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)]
dp1_first = [0] * (N + 1)
dp1_second = [0] * (N + 1)
dp2_first = [[[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)] for _ in range(2)]
dp2_second = [[[0] * (N + 1) for _ in range(N + 1)] for _ in range(2)]

def ad(x, y):
    x[0] += y
    if x[0] >= md:
        x[0] -= md

def sm(n):
    return n * (n + 1) // 2

# Precompute binomial coefficients
for i in range(m + 1):
    ch[i][0] = 1
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        ch[i][j] = ch[i - 1][j] + ch[i - 1][j - 1]
        if ch[i][j] >= md:
            ch[i][j] -= md

dp1_first[0] = 1
dp1_second[0] = 0
for i in range(1, m + 1):
    for j in range(1, i + 1):
        w = (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j]) % md
        w = (w * ch[i - 1][j - 1]) % md
        temp_second = 0
        ad([temp_second], (sm(j - 1) + sm(i - j)) * w % md)
        ad([temp_second], (dp1_second[j - 1] * dp1_first[i - j] % md) * (i + 1) * ch[i - 1][j - 1] % md)
        ad([temp_second], (dp1_first[j - 1] * dp1_second[i - j] % md) * (i + 1) * ch[i - 1][j - 1] % md)
        dp1_first[i] = (dp1_first[i] + w * (i + 1)) % md
        dp1_second[i] = (dp1_second[i] + temp_second) % md

dp2_first[0][0][0] = 1
dp2_second[0][0][0] = 0
dp2_first[1][0][0] = 1
dp2_second[1][0][0] = 0

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i + 1):
        for ln in range(1, n - i + 1):
            # Update dp2 for index 1
            ad([dp2_first[1][i + ln][j]], dp2_first[0][i][j])
            ad([dp2_second[1][i + ln][j]], dp2_second[0][i][j])
            # Update dp2 for index 0
            val1 = (dp2_first[1][i][j] * dp1_first[ln]) % md
            val2 = (dp2_first[1][i][j] * dp1_second[ln]) % md
            val3 = (dp2_second[1][i][j] * dp1_first[ln]) % md
            ch_j_ln = ch[j + ln][j]
            ad([dp2_first[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val1 * ch_j_ln % md)
            ad([dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val2 * ch_j_ln % md)
            ad([dp2_second[0][i + ln][j + ln]], val3 * ch_j_ln % md)

ans = (dp2_second[0][n][m] + dp2_second[1][n][m]) % md
print(ans)
